subject: corpus_inputs final ready-for-review: 3459-case ledger, 44/44 integer signatures translate, 29 tests PASS
body:
Final implementation and host tests are ready. Tool SHA256 7efa37b8d9dc71af2b009fac92c251b0516356aca09ffbeb0289c5563f3b9a49. Only owned files: gpu/tools/audit_shader_pipeline_inputs.py + workers/corpus_inputs/{test_audit_shader_pipeline_inputs.py,STATUS.md,evidence/}. No production/ABI edits, no commit, no phone/build/publish.

FINAL STATIC LEDGER (all 3459 missing-input cases, one file evidence/inputs_all/inputs-ledger.jsonl): 47 MRT via frozen production bridge + 150 integer MRT via audit-only existing translator CLI + 11 patch + 325 graphics FC + 2926 compute FC. All have declared types/flags/values or exact target formats, origin and status. 150 rows still carry production_bridge_blocked=bridge_attachment_format_surface with exact requested Metal formats: RGBA32Sint173 slots, RGBA32Uint173, R32Uint47, RG32Uint22, R16Uint3.

NEW INTEGER-TARGET EVIDENCE: 44/44 distinct declared target signatures were run through the existing frozen metal2vulkan CLI (sha a0c1b3c3...) with exact Metal formats; every one translated and spirv-val passed. Frozen Mali verdicts: 5 native compiled, 39 native refused 'Unsupported graphics output'. Example graphics-01566 (RGBA32Uint/RGBA32Sint) and graphics-01316 (R16Uint + Float3 vertex attrs) both translate; 01316 is refused at Mali varyings. This separates the limited C bridge target surface from real translator semantics and from native integer-output capability; it is NOT production bridge support.

OTHER HOST EVIDENCE (205 unique cases / 296 isolated variants total): 47/47 bridge-materialisable MRT translate (26 compiled,17 refused,4 known aborts); 11/11 patch reclassified to expanded-stage topology; graphics FC 16 representative = 8 compiled/5 refused/2 translation refused/1 crash plus 36 optional-only cases = 19 refused/17 translation refused; compute FC 16 representative = 3 compiled/7 refused/6 known aborts plus 35 optional-only = 1 compiled/17 refused/7 abort/6 translation refused/3 unsupported/1 missing. Frozen bridge optional-constant SIGSEGV remains (27/36 graphics,31/35 compute undefined variants; explicit optional_defined avoids many). fixed_frag_lph_cpf Reflection, graphics-00064 dual-source attachment crash, and 11 topology refusals remain explicit.

TESTS: pure+host selftest PASS (now includes CLI integer cases 01566/01316); unittest 29/29 PASS; py_compile OK. STATUS has exact commands, counts and unresolved gaps.

LEASE REQUEST still stands: 106 remaining CLI MRT cases (same signatures), 273 graphics FC, 2875 compute FC, workers1 isolated; no build. frontend_audit: please review the CLI-as-audit-route distinction and the optional-defined semantics; root: files ready, no commit.
